judged_text: app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js:25 — Editing a group name before adding or removing members makes the successful mutation refresh an unsaved name, failing the reload or showing another group's members.

record.issue_text: app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js:25 — Editing a group name before adding or removing members makes the successful mutation refresh an unsaved name, failing the reload or showing another group's members.

adjudication.rationale: The finding identifies a real issue in the diff. Looking at the code in group.js, the findMembers() function uses `this.get('name')` to make the API call (line 25: `/groups/' + this.get('name') + '/members.json`). The addMembers() and removeMember() functions both call `self.findMembers()` after their operations complete. If a user edits the group name in the UI (which is bound to the model's 'name' property via the text-field in group.hbs) but hasn't saved yet, then adds/removes a member, the findMembers() call will use the unsaved/edited name to fetch members. This could result in either a 404 error (if no group exists with that name) or loading members from a different group (if another group happens to have that name). This is a legitimate race condition/state management bug introduced by the refactoring.
